key_insight: Orthogonalized updates paired with gradient-norm-based adaptive stepsizes stabilize coupled minimax optimization while avoiding problem-dependent tuning.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce stepsize-tuning effort in machine-learning systems trained through coupled minimization and maximization.
method: Orthogonalize update directions to reduce update anisotropy.
Use accumulated gradient norms to adapt and balance primal-dual stepsizes in AdaSGDA.
Add variance reduction in AdaSGDA-VR to improve the theoretical convergence rate.
evidence_signal: For nonconvex–strongly-concave problems, the paper proves convergence rates of O(T^(-1/4)) for AdaSGDA and O(T^(-1/3)) for AdaSGDA-VR; the abstract reports competitive experimental performance without specifying benchmarks.
watch_item: The stated guarantees rely on strong concavity in the maximization variable and do not establish performance for general nonconvex–nonconcave problems.
paper_title: Orthogonal Updates for the Win: Towards Accelerated Adaptive Minimax Optimization
